In [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]], a '''Human male''' flew as a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] in the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant's]] [[181st Imperial Fighter Wing/Legends|181st Imperial Fighter Group]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]] saw him and three other 181st pilots travel to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Adumar/Legends|Adumar]] as Imperial emissaries. The 181st's [[Commander/Legends|commander]], [[Turr Phennir/Legends|Turr Phennir]], led the delegation as they wooed the government of the nation state of [[Cartann]] to join the Empire. Complicating matters was the presence of four [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] pilots also in [[Cartann City]], arguing the New Republic's case.

The Imperial pilots spent their [[Standard day/Legends|days]] on Adumar engaging local pilots in [[Starfighter combat/Legends|aerial duels]] to the [[Death/Legends|death]]. In line with local customs, they gained considerable honor. Cartann eventually declared [[Adumari Civil War|war]] on the other nations of Adumar, and the Imperials fought for them against attacking forces of the [[Yedagon Confederacy]]. The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] was the second Imperial pilot to die, shot down by the guns of New Republic pilot [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]].

==Behind the scenes==
In ''[[X-Wing: Starfighters of Adumar]]'', one of Phennir's men is described as being a tall, [[Color/Legends|red]]-[[Hair/Legends|headed]] man. It is unclear if that man is the pilot described in this article or one of the [[Unidentified 181st pilot|two]] [[Unidentified 181st pilot 3|other]] men on Phennir's ambassadorial team.
